answer_1.quote: Text style transfer aims to endow a text with a different style while keeping its main semantic content unaltered.

answer_2.quote: Specifically, we adopt the following automatic metrics: (1) Style Transfer Accuracy: We use two variants of style transfer accuracy following , absolute accuracy (a-Acc) and relative accuracy (r-Acc). ... (2) Content Preservation: We use BLEU-n (n=1,2) and BERTScore (BS) between generated and input texts to measure their lexical and semantic similarity, respectively.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sampled 100 fairy tales from the Chinese dataset, and obtained 800 generated texts from StoryTrans and three baseline models. Then, we hire three Chinese native speakers to evaluate in three aspects including style transfer accuracy (Sty.), content preservation (Con.) and coherence (Coh.).
answer_4.guideline: We ask the annotators to judge each aspect from 1 (the worst) to 3 (the best).
